ex.s: You do not have to be a fan to recognise the skill of professional players - how they use their bodies to pass, score and defend can be amazing to see - or to fell the excitement of a game ending with a surprising twist.

ex.s: First, researchers need to identify all the players in that system; second, they must work out how they relate to each other; and third, they need to understand and quantify the impact of those relationships on each other and on those outside the system.
ex.t: 首先，研究人员需要识别该系统中的所有参与者；其次，他们必须弄清楚彼此之间的关系；第三，他们需要理解和量化这些关系对彼此以及对系统外各方的影响。

ex.s: B The relationships among players have been clarified.

ex.s: The results are mixed For football and basketball，adding talented players to a team proves a good method，but only up to the point where 70% of the players are top talent；above that level, the team’s performance begins to decline.
ex.t: 对于足球和篮球来说，效果不一：为球队增添有天赋的球员被证明是个好办法，但仅限于70%的球员都是顶尖人才的程度；超过这一水平，球队的表现就开始下滑。

ex.s: She trained hard, so she became a great player later.
ex.t: 她刻苦训练，所以后来成了一名伟大的球员。
